messages:
marta: urgent - deploy caused a regression that dropped auth-event detail. need a one-hour export (2026-04-05T14:00:00Z -> 2026-04-05T15:00:00Z) to repro. This must be handled as emergency access.
lee: tag me. are we storing any full emails/ssn tokens in that window?
marta: maybe emails and device_ip fields. proposal: no S3 persistence. Create ephemeral export encrypted with a per-export ephemeral KMS key (generated by KMS-ephemeral API), deliver via signed HTTPS URL valid 4h, then auto-delete.
auditor-bot: policy check: emergency exports require 2 approvers OR oncall + auditor, per-export audit log, per-export salt for hashing, and HSM-backed key.
oncall-aaron: i'm oncall; i can approve if we meet HSM key + MFA unwrap for download. Also need exact scrub spec.
infra-jen: we have a workflow for ephemeral uploads -> pre-signed-url flow. can wire KMS-ephemeral to create a one-time-decrypt key that expires. Will need an infra ticket and temp role.
marta: minimal privileges requested: role "emergency-exporter" with ["siem:query","siem:export:ephemeral"], duration 2h. auditors: @sec-ops.
sec-ops: require that device_ip -> mask /24, email -> hash+salt, user_agent trimmed to first 80 chars, and remove oauth_token. No raw PII in output. Salt must be stored in vault and rotated after deletion.
lee: also require that the ephemeral KMS key be HSM provenance (key_origin=HSM) and restricted to the export principal.
auditor-bot: checklist: ticket created, vault entry for SALT, temp role PR, KMS ephemeral request, oncall note, export audit hook present. any missing item blocks.
marta: created ticket SEC-2710. SALT stored at vault://sec/SEC-2710/salt. PR for role in progress.
infra-jen: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2899 adds emergency-exporter role and ephemeral upload lambda. reviewers: @sre @seceng.
oncall-aaron: i need the CLI steps i'll run. include exact curl or aws cli command in the ticket.
marta: sample run (will redact sensitive bits):
```bash
aws siem start-export --query "service=auth AND ts>\"2026-04-05T14:00:00Z\" AND ts<\"2026-04-05T15:00:00Z\"" \
  --scrub 'email=sha256+salt:SEC-2710,device_ip=mask/24,remove=oauth_token' \
  --destination ephemeral-kms://request/SEC-2710 \
  --notify s3://no-storage-placeholder
```
infra-jen: once PR merges i'll trigger the ephemeral KMS request KMS-1301. KMS-ops needs to set key_origin=HSM and expiration=6h.
sec-ops: approve conditional on: 1) SALT in vault 2) MFA by oncall for download 3) audit events for grant, decrypt, and delete visible in auditlog service.
oncall-aaron: i confirm MFA step. i'll perform the unwrap and download. Put instructions in ticket with exact commands and expected audit strings.
lee: i left a minor comment on PR to tighten IAM actions to exact resource ARNs. please fix before merge.
infra-jen: fixed. merging now.
auditor-bot: infra PR merged. KMS request KMS-1301 filed. awaiting KMS-ops approval.
sec-ops: KMS-ops approved the ephemeral key with HSM origin. final check: SALT present, MFA configured, audit streaming set. i'm approving the export.
marta: kicking the export now. export job id=E-4442 created. ephemeral-url expires 4h from 2026-04-05T14:05:00Z. download requires MFA prompt from oncall.
oncall-aaron: performed MFA, downloaded snapshot, verified scrub rules applied. auditlog entries: grant=authz#E-4442, decrypt=crypto#E-4442, download=net#E-4442.
sec-ops: verified audit events and SALT usage. scheduling deletion job to run in 24h.
auditor-bot: export E-4442 closed. retention: auto-delete in 24h, vault SALT rotation scheduled post-delete.
marta: thanks team. follow-ups: add an "emergency ephemeral export" template to docs and add a checklist for HSM key creation to KMS runbook.
lee: recommend adding an automated lint to ensure no S3 writes happen for ephemeral exports.
infra-jen: noted, filing infra ticket INF-5021 for lint.
sec-ops: closing thread, tagging postmortem in SEC-2710.
